script_text: Stop! Cancer, the stars are screaming at you right now. Venus is forming a harmonious trine to your Moon today, flooding your 4th House of Home and Family with nurturing energy. This cosmic alignment creates the perfect atmosphere for emotional healing and domestic harmony. Single Cancers should expect a meaningful connection with someone who values emotional security, while those in relationships will find deeper intimacy through vulnerability. Career-wise, Mercury in your 10th House is sextiling Saturn, bringing practical solutions to workplace challenges and potential recognition for your efforts. Warning: Avoid taking things personally today — not everyone shares your emotional depth. An unexpected gift or gesture of appreciation may arrive from someone you least expect. Follow for tomorrow's reading before this energy shifts.
